saltwater-crocodile.name: Saltwater Crocodile
saltwater-crocodile.overview: The saltwater crocodile (or Crocodylus porosus) is an extremely large species of reptile native to the coastal areas of Southeast Asia, North Australia and East India.

western-lowland-gorilla.name: Western Lowland Gorilla
western-lowland-gorilla.overview: The Western lowland gorilla (or Gorilla gorilla gorilla) is native to Cameroon, Equatorial Guinea, Gabon, Republic of the Congo and Southern Niger, living and foraging in the rainforests, swamp forests and abandoned farmland there.

african-leopard.name: African Leopard
african-leopard.overview: The African leopard (or Panthera pardus pardus) is the nominate subspecies of the leopard, native to Central and Southern Africa.

lion.name: Lion
lion.overview: The lion (or Panthera leo) inhabits savannahs, grasslands, and open woodlands across sub-Saharan Africa and Asia (where they only survive in Western India today).

red-lionfish.name: Red Lionfish
red-lionfish.overview: The red lionfish (or Pterois volitans) is a venomous reef fish native to the Indo-Pacific region, including the Red Sea, Indian Ocean, and western Pacific.

javan-green-magpie.name: Javan Green Magpie
javan-green-magpie.overview: The Javan green magpie (or Cissa thalassina) is an endemic passerine bird species found only on the Indonesian island of Java, primarily in the Western and Central regions.

west-indian-manatee.name: West Indian Manatee
west-indian-manatee.overview: The West Indian manatee (or Trichechus manatus) is a large marine mammal found in shallow coastal waters, rivers, and estuaries throughout the southeastern United States, the Caribbean, and parts of Central and South America.

sumatran-orangutan.name: Sumatran Orangutan
sumatran-orangutan.overview: The Sumatran orangutan (or Pongo abelii) is a great ape endemic to the Indonesian island of Sumatra.

common-ostrich.name: Common Ostrich
common-ostrich.overview: The common ostrich (or Struthio camelus) is the largest known bird species in the world.

long-eared-owl.name: Long-Eared Owl
long-eared-owl.overview: The long-eared owl (or Asio otus), also known as the Northern long-eared owl, lesser horned owl, or cat owl, is a medium-sized owl found across much of Europe, Asia, North America, and parts of North Africa.

giant-panda.name: Giant Panda
giant-panda.overview: The giant panda (or Ailuropoda melanoleuca) is a species of bear native to the mountains of Central China.

sunda-pangolin.name: Sunda Pangolin
sunda-pangolin.overview: The Sunda pangolin (or Manis javanica) is also sometimes called the Malayan pangolin or Javan pangolin.

black-rhinoceros.name: Black Rhinoceros
black-rhinoceros.overview: The black rhinoceros (or Diceros bicornis), also known as the hook-lipped rhinoceros, is a large ungulate native to the grasslands and scrublands of Southern and Eastern Africa.

secretarybird.name: Secretarybird
secretarybird.overview: The secretarybird (or Sagittarius serpentarius) is a large bird of prey that is found throughout the savannahs of Sub-Saharan Africa.

indo-pacific-leopard-shark.name: Indo-Pacific Leopard Shark
indo-pacific-leopard-shark.overview: The Indo-Pacific leopard shark (or Stegostoma tigrinum), also known as the zebra shark, is a distinctive and slow-moving benthic shark.

shoebill.name: Shoebill
shoebill.overview: The shoebill (or Balaeniceps rex), also known as the shoe-billed stork, whale-headed stork or whalebill, is a large, solitary wading bird that inhabits tropical East African freshwater swamps.

pacific-bluefin-tuna.name: Pacific Bluefin Tuna
pacific-bluefin-tuna.overview: The Pacific bluefin tuna (or Thunnus orientalis) is a large, migratory fish found throughout the North Pacific Ocean, with a range extending from the waters off Japan and Korea, across to the western coast of North America, from Alaska down to Mexico.

aardvark.name: Aardvark
aardvark.overview: The aardvark (or Orycteropus afer) is a medium-sized insectivore that lives throughout Sub-Saharan Africa.

clown-anemonefish.name: Clown Anemonefish
clown-anemonefish.overview: Clown anemonefish (or Amphiprion ocellaris) inhabit shallow coral reefs and sheltered lagoons across the Indo-Pacific region, including areas around Indonesia, the Philippines, northern Australia, and parts of the Indian Ocean.

nyala.name: Nyala
nyala.overview: The nyala (or Tragelaphus angasii), also called the lowland nyala, is a secretive antelope that lives in the thick undergrowth of the South-Eastern African savannah.

sable-antelope.name: Sable Antelope
sable-antelope.overview: The sable antelope (or Hippotragus niger) is a species of ungulate that lives in South-Eastern Africa, where they graze and browse on the savannah, preferring lightly wooded areas to completely open ones.

springbok.name: Springbok
springbok.overview: The springbok (or Antidorcas marsupialis) is a small species of antelope native to the savannahs of Southern Africa.

north-sulawesi-babirusa.name: North Sulawesi Babirusa
north-sulawesi-babirusa.overview: The North Sulawesi babirusa (or Babyrousa celebensis) is a species of pig native to the Sulawesi island of Indonesia and several small surrounding islands.

schooling-bannerfish.name: Schooling Bannerfish
schooling-bannerfish.overview: The schooling bannerfish (or Heniochus diphreutes) is a marine fish found across the Indo-Pacific region, ranging from the eastern coast of Africa and the Red Sea to the central Pacific, including Indonesia, Australia, and Hawaii.

longfin-batfish.name: Longfin Batfish
longfin-batfish.overview: The longfin batfish (or Platax pinnatus), also known as the pinnate spadefish; or pinnate, dusky, shaded or red-faced batfish, is a species of marine fish found in the tropical coastal regions of the West Pacific Ocean at depths between 3m and 25m.

eurasian-brown-bear.name: Eurasian Brown Bear
eurasian-brown-bear.overview: Ranging from Europe to Central Russia, where it inhabits boreal and temperate forests, grasslands, and wetlands, the Eurasian brown bear (or Ursus arctos arctos) is a subspecies of the brown bear.

grizzly-bear.name: Grizzly Bear
grizzly-bear.overview: Native to the northern USA and Canada, the grizzly bear (or Ursus arctos horribilis) is a subspecies of the brown bear.

sun-bear.name: Sun Bear
sun-bear.overview: The sun bear (or Helarctos malayanus) is a small species of bear that lives in the tropical rainforests of Southeast Asia.

eurasian-beaver.name: Eurasian Beaver
eurasian-beaver.overview: The Eurasian beaver (or Castor fiber) is a large species of rodent that lives in the temperate woodland and riverine areas of Europe and Asia.

goliath-beetle.name: Goliath Beetle
goliath-beetle.overview: The Goliath beetle (or Goliathus goliatus) is a large species of insect that lives in the savannah and rainforests of Central Africa.

sacred-scarab-beetle.name: Sacred Scarab Beetle
sacred-scarab-beetle.overview: The sacred scarab beetle (or Scarabaeus sacer) is a dung beetle native to the coastal dunes and marshes around the Mediterranean Sea in Northern Africa, Europe and the Middle East.

binturong.name: Binturong
binturong.overview: The binturong (or Arctictis binturong), also known as the bearcat, is a species of mammal that lives in the forests of South and Southeast Asia.

european-bison.name: European Bison
european-bison.overview: The European bison (or Bison bonasus), also commonly referred to as the wisent, is a large ungulate living in the forests and meadows of Poland, Russia, Belarus, Lithuania, Ukraine, and Slovakia, in Eastern Europe.

eurasian-bittern.name: Eurasian Bittern
eurasian-bittern.overview: The Eurasian bittern (or Botaurus stellaris), also known as the great bittern, is a large species of heron found across Europe, Asia, and parts of North Africa.

wild-boar.name: Wild Boar
wild-boar.overview: The wild boar (or Sus scrofa), also known as the Eurasian wild pig, is a pig native throughout the temperate regions of Europe, Asia, and areas of Northern Africa.

cape-buffalo.name: Cape Buffalo
cape-buffalo.overview: The Cape buffalo (or Syncerus caffer caffer) inhabits a wide range of ecosystems across sub-Saharan Africa, including savannas, open woodlands, floodplains, and grasslands, but it is always closely tied to permanent water sources.

cloudless-sulphur.name: Cloudless Sulphur
cloudless-sulphur.overview: The cloudless sulphur (or Phoebis sennae) is a butterfly found in temperate open areas – grasslands, parks, gardens, watercourses and seashores – of North, Central and South America.

european-peacock.name: European Peacock
european-peacock.overview: The European peacock (or Aglais io) is a species of butterfly living throughout the temperate grasslands and woodlands of Europe and Asia.

sri-lankan-rose.name: Sri Lankan Rose
sri-lankan-rose.overview: The Sri Lankan rose (or Pachliopta jophon), also known as the Ceylon rose, is a swallowtail butterfly native to the rainforests of Southwestern Sri Lanka.

menelaus-blue-morpho.name: Menelaus Blue Morpho
menelaus-blue-morpho.overview: The Menelaus blue morpho (or Morpho menelaus) is a butterfly species found in the tropical grasslands and woodlands of Central and South America.

monarch.name: Monarch
monarch.overview: The monarch butterfly (or Danaus plexippus) is found in a wide range worldwide but is most commonly seen in North and South America.

old-world-swallowtail.name: Old World Swallowtail
old-world-swallowtail.overview: The Old World swallowtail (or Papilio machaon) is a butterfly living in the temperate regions, woodlands and even tundras of Europe, Asia and North America.

bactrian-camel.name: Bactrian Camel
bactrian-camel.overview: The Bactrian camel (or Camelus bactrianus) is a large ungulate native to Central Asia.

koi.name: Koi
koi.overview: The koi is a domesticated and selectively bred form of carp, with ancestor species likely including the Eurasian carp (or Cyprinus carpio) and the Amur carp (or Cyprinus rubrofuscus).

amazonian-giant-centipede.name: Amazonian Giant Centipede
amazonian-giant-centipede.overview: The Amazonian giant centipede (or Scolopendra gigantea) is a large, fearsome and predatory arthropod that is native to the forests of South America and the Caribbean.

western-chimpanzee.name: Western Chimpanzee
western-chimpanzee.overview: The Western chimpanzee (or Pan troglodytes verus) is a subspecies of the common chimpanzee native to the forests of Guinea, Liberia, Senegal, Sierra Leone and the Ivory Coast.

blunthead-cichlid.name: Blunthead Cichlid
blunthead-cichlid.overview: The blunthead cichlid (or Tropheus moori) is a freshwater cichlid endemic to Lake Tanganyika in East Africa, where it inhabits shallow, rocky shorelines with strong water movement and abundant algae growth.

boa-constrictor.name: Boa Constrictor
boa-constrictor.overview: The boa constrictor is a large species of snake native to Central and South America.

yellow-anaconda.name: Yellow Anaconda
yellow-anaconda.overview: The yellow anaconda (or Eunectes notaeus) is a large species of constrictor snake that lives in the tributaries, swamps and marshes of the Paraguay river basin, found mainly in Paraguay, Bolivia, Argentina and Brazil.

threespot-damselfish.name: Threespot Damselfish
threespot-damselfish.overview: The threespot damselfish (or Dascyllus trimaculatus), also known as the threespot humbug or domino damselfish, is a widespread species found throughout the tropical Indo-Pacific region from the Red Sea and East Africa to Hawaii, Japan and northern Australia.

red-deer.name: Red Deer
red-deer.overview: The red deer (or Cervus elaphus) is a widespread species of ungulate that lives throughout the temperate grasslands, woodlands and scrublands of Europe, Northern Africa and Central Asia.

african-wild-dog.name: African Wild Dog
african-wild-dog.overview: African wild dogs (or Lycaon pictus) are also known as Cape hunting dogs or painted wolves.

dolphinfish.name: Dolphinfish
dolphinfish.overview: The dolphinfish (or Coryphaena hippurus), also known as the mahi-mahi, is a brightly coloured pelagic fish found in warm oceanic waters around the world, typically inhabiting tropical and subtropical regions of the Atlantic, Pacific, and Indian Oceans.

golden-eagle.name: Golden Eagle
golden-eagle.overview: The golden eagle (or Aquila chrysaetos) is one of the most widespread birds of prey, ranging across the Northern Hemisphere in North America, Europe, Asia, and parts of North Africa.

white-tailed-sea-eagle.name: White-Tailed Sea-Eagle
white-tailed-sea-eagle.overview: The white-tailed sea-eagle (or Haliaeetus albicilla), also called white-tailed eagle, grey sea eagle or Eurasian sea eagle, is a large bird of prey found across Northern and Eastern Europe, parts of Asia, and coastal regions around the North Pacific.

african-savannah-elephant.name: African Savannah Elephant
african-savannah-elephant.overview: Native to the savannahs and mountains of Sub-Saharan Africa, the African savannah elephant (or Loxodonta africana) is a large, thickset mammal with grey skin and a characteristic trunk used for vocalising, drinking and grasping food.

asian-elephant.name: Asian Elephant
asian-elephant.overview: Native to both Central and Southeast Asia, the Asian elephant (or Elephas maximus) is a species distinguishable by a distinctive trunk, small ears, and grey skin with pink mottling around the face.

greater-flamingo.name: Greater Flamingo
greater-flamingo.overview: The greater flamingo (or Phoenicopterus roseus) is a large species of migratory bird that is widespread across Europe, the Middle East, Asia and Africa.

american-bullfrog.name: American Bullfrog
american-bullfrog.overview: The American bullfrog (or Aquarana catesbeianus) is a large species of amphibian that lives in the swamps, ponds and lakes of the USA and Canada.

giant-slippery-frog.name: Giant Slippery Frog
giant-slippery-frog.overview: The giant slippery frog (or Conraua goliath), sometimes called the goliath frog, is an extremely large species of frog that lives in the African rainforests of Cameroon and Equatorial Guinea, specifically in the fast-flowing rivers and streams.

blue-and-gold-fusilier.name: Blue and Gold Fusilier
blue-and-gold-fusilier.overview: The blue and gold fusilier (or Caesio teres) is a marine fish found widely across the tropical Indo-Pacific region.

thomson-s-gazelle.name: Thomson's Gazelle
thomson-s-gazelle.overview: Thomson's gazelle (or Eudorcas thomsonii) is a small species of grazing mammal that lives in Africa's Serengeti regions of Tanzania and Kenya.

gharial.name: Gharial
gharial.overview: Gharials (or Gavialis gangeticus) are a crocodilian native to the rivers of the Indian subcontinent, surviving in just four stretches of river in Nepal and Northern India.

siamang.name: Siamang
siamang.overview: The siamang (or Symphalangus syndactylus) is a species of gibbon living in the rainforests of the Malay Peninsula and Indonesian island of Sumatra.

masai-giraffe.name: Masai Giraffe
masai-giraffe.overview: The Masai giraffe (or Giraffa tippelskirchi) is a species of giraffe that lives in the savannahs and open forests of Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda.

reticulated-giraffe.name: Reticulated Giraffe
reticulated-giraffe.overview: Also known as the Somali giraffe, the reticulated giraffe (or Giraffa reticulata) is a giraffe that lives in the savannahs and open forests of Kenya, Somalia and Ethiopia.

giant-gourami.name: Giant Gourami
giant-gourami.overview: The giant gourami (or Osphronemus goramy) is a large freshwater fish native to Southeast Asia, particularly the Mekong and Chao Phraya river basins, and is now widely introduced across Asia, Africa, and parts of Australia for aquaculture and ornamental purposes.

giant-grouper.name: Giant Grouper
giant-grouper.overview: The giant grouper (or Epinephelus lanceolatus) is also known as the Queensland or brindle grouper and inhabits tropical and subtropical marine waters of the Indo-Pacific region, ranging from the Red Sea and East Africa across the Indian Ocean to Southeast Asia, northern Australia, and the western Pa

mountain-hare.name: Mountain Hare
mountain-hare.overview: The mountain hare (or Lepus timidus) is a medium-sized lagomorph native to northern and central Eurasia, ranging from Scotland and Scandinavia across Russia to parts of northern China, Mongolia, and the Japanese island of Hokkaido.

common-hippopotamus.name: Common Hippopotamus
common-hippopotamus.overview: The common hippopotamus (or Hippopotamus amphibius) is a large mammal native to the rivers of Sub-Saharan Africa.

great-hornbill.name: Great Hornbill
great-hornbill.overview: The great hornbill (or Buceros bicornis) is a large bird ranging from Southwest and Northern India and Bhutan through Myanmar, Thailand, Malaysia, and into Sumatra, where it lives in montane and lowland rainforests.

przewalski-s-horse.name: Przewalski's Horse
przewalski-s-horse.overview: Przewalski’s horse (or Equus ferus przewalskii) is a species of wild horse living in the steppes of Mongolia, also known as the takhi, Mongolian wild horse and the Dzungarian horse.
przewalski-s-horse.wildPop: 1,900 reintroduced, semi-wild in national parks and reserves

spotted-hyena.name: Spotted Hyena
spotted-hyena.overview: The spotted hyena (or Crocuta crocuta), also known as the laughing hyena, is native to sub-Saharan Africa.

giant-malaysian-leaf-insect.name: Giant Malaysian Leaf Insect
giant-malaysian-leaf-insect.overview: The giant Malaysian leaf insect (or Pulchriphyllium giganteum) is a large species of insect that lives in the Western tropical rainforests of Malaysia.

moon-jelly.name: Moon Jelly
moon-jelly.overview: The moon jelly (or Aurelia aurita) is a widespread species of jellyfish found in coastal waters around the world, particularly in temperate and tropical seas.

goodfellow-s-tree-kangaroo.name: Goodfellow's Tree-Kangaroo
goodfellow-s-tree-kangaroo.overview: Goodfellow’s tree-kangaroo (or Dendrolagus goodfellowi) is an arboreal marsupial native to the montane and mid-montane rainforests of Papua New Guinea and Indonesia.

ring-tailed-lemur.name: Ring-Tailed Lemur
ring-tailed-lemur.overview: Like all species of lemur, the ring-tailed lemur (or Lemur catta) is native to Madagascar and is not naturally found anywhere else in the world.

snow-leopard.name: Snow Leopard
snow-leopard.overview: The snow leopard (or Panthera uncia), identifiable by its white to grey fur, black rosettes across its body, and black spots on its face, lives in the mountains of Nepal, Tibet, Northern India, Southern Siberia, Pakistan, Bhutan and Mongolia.

common-bluetongue.name: Common Bluetongue
common-bluetongue.overview: The common bluetongue (or Tiliqua scincoides), also called common blue-tongued lizard or blue-tongued skink is a species of reptile that lives in the woodland, scrubland and semi-desert areas of Australia.

gila-monster.name: Gila Monster
gila-monster.overview: The Gila monster (or Heloderma suspectum) is a large species of venomous lizard native to the arid regions of the Southern United States and Northern Mexico.

komodo-dragon.name: Komodo Dragon
komodo-dragon.overview: The Komodo dragon (or Varanus komodoensis) is a large species of reptile that lives on the Indonesian isles of Komodo, Rinca, Flores, Gili Dasami, and Gili Motang.

nile-monitor.name: Nile Monitor
nile-monitor.overview: The Nile monitor (or Varanus niloticus) is a large species of reptile that lives in the non-desert area of Sub-Saharan Africa, and prefer environments close to water.

clown-loach.name: Clown Loach
clown-loach.overview: The clown loach (or Chromobotia macracanthus) is a freshwater fish native to slow-moving rivers and streams of Southeast Asia, particularly the islands of Borneo and Sumatra.

eurasian-lynx.name: Eurasian Lynx
eurasian-lynx.overview: The Eurasian lynx (or Lynx lynx) is a medium-sized cat that is found in temperate and boreal forest and mountains of Europe and Asia.

meerkat.name: Meerkat
meerkat.overview: The Meerkat (or Suricata suricatta) is a species of social mongoose found in complex underground burrows in the savannahs and semi-deserts of Southern Africa.

golden-lion-tamarin.name: Golden Lion Tamarin
golden-lion-tamarin.overview: The golden lion tamarin (or Leontopithecus rosalia) is a New World primate native to the Atlantic coastal rainforests of southeastern Brazil, living primarily in humid lowland and secondary forests.

gemsbok.name: Gemsbok
gemsbok.overview: The gemsbok (or Oryx gazella) is a species of antelope, also sometimes called the South African oryx, that lives in the Kalahari and Namib deserts of Southern Africa.

asian-small-clawed-otter.name: Asian Small-Clawed Otter
asian-small-clawed-otter.overview: Native to the rivers and streams of Central and Southeast Asia, the Asian small-clawed otter (or Aonyx cinereus) is the smallest otter species in the world.

red-panda.name: Red Panda
red-panda.overview: The red panda (or Ailurus fulgens) is a small mammal that lives in the woodlands of the Himalayas and multiple areas of China.

long-tailed-parakeet.name: Long-Tailed Parakeet
long-tailed-parakeet.overview: The long-tailed parakeet (or Belocercus longicaudus) is a medium-sized parrot native to Southeast Asia, found across the Malay Peninsula, Sumatra, Borneo and surrounding islands.

african-penguin.name: African Penguin
african-penguin.overview: The African penguin (or Spheniscus demersus) is a flightless bird that inhabits the coastline and islands of South Africa and Namibia.

blackspotted-puffer.name: Blackspotted Puffer
blackspotted-puffer.overview: The blackspotted pufferfish (or Arothron nigropunctatus), also known as the dog-faced pufferfish, is a tropical marine fish commonly found throughout the Indo-Pacific region from the Eastern coast of Africa to the islands of the central Pacific Ocean.

boeseman-s-rainbowfish.name: Boeseman's Rainbowfish
boeseman-s-rainbowfish.overview: The Boeseman’s rainbowfish (or Melanotaenia boesemani) is a small, brightly coloured freshwater fish endemic to the Ayamaru Lakes and their tributaries in the Vogelkop (Bird’s Head) Peninsula of West Papua, Indonesia, where it inhabits shallow lakes and slow-moving waters with vegetation and clear w

javanese-cownose-ray.name: Javanese Cownose Ray
javanese-cownose-ray.overview: The Javanese cownose ray (or Rhinoptera javanica) is a coastal species found in the warm, shallow waters of the Indo-Pacific region, ranging from the Red Sea and eastern Africa across the Indian Ocean to Southeast Asia and northern Australia.

ocellated-eagle-ray.name: Ocellated Eagle Ray
ocellated-eagle-ray.overview: The ocellated eagle ray (or Aetobatus ocellatus) inhabits warm, coastal waters of tropical and subtropical regions throughout the Indo-Pacific, and parts of the eastern Pacific.

common-rudd.name: Common Rudd
common-rudd.overview: The common rudd (or Scardinius erythrophthalmus) is a widespread freshwater fish native to much of Europe and western Asia, though it has also been introduced to North America, New Zealand, and parts of Africa.

axolotl.name: Axolotl
axolotl.overview: The axolotl (or Ambystoma mexicanum) is an amphibian found exclusively in freshwater lakes in Mexico, with only Lake Xochimilco remaining as their natural habitat.

danube-crested-newt.name: Danube Crested Newt
danube-crested-newt.overview: The Danube crested newt (or Triturus dobrogicus) is an amphibian species living in the slow-flowing waters, tributaries and surrounding woodlands of the Danube River.

fire-salamander.name: Fire Salamander
fire-salamander.overview: The fire salamander (or Salamandra salamandra) is an amphibian living in the deciduous forests throughout mainland Europe.

pacific-sardine.name: Pacific Sardine
pacific-sardine.overview: The Pacific sardine (or Sardinops sagax) is a small species of schooling fish that lives in the subtropical and temperate waters of the Pacific and Indian Oceans and is also found in the Atlantic Ocean around South Africa.

giant-forest-scorpion.name: Giant Forest Scorpion
giant-forest-scorpion.overview: The giant forest scorpion (or Gigantometrus swammerdami) is a large species of arachnid that lives in the tropical rainforests of India and Sri Lanka.

indo-pacific-sergeant.name: Indo-Pacific Sergeant
indo-pacific-sergeant.overview: The Indo-Pacific sergeant (or Abudefduf vaigiensis) is a damselfish found widely across the Indo-Pacific region, from the Red Sea and East Africa to Japan, Australia, and the Pacific Islands.

blacktip-reef-shark.name: Blacktip Reef Shark
blacktip-reef-shark.overview: The blacktip reef shark (or Carcharhinus melanopterus, not to be confused with the blacktip shark, Carcharhinus limbatus), is a medium-sized shark living in the reefs and epipelagic waters of the Indo-Pacific Ocean.

great-hammerhead.name: Great Hammerhead
great-hammerhead.overview: The great hammerhead (or Sphyrna mokarran) is a large species of shark that inhabits warm temperate and tropical waters worldwide.

sand-tiger-shark.name: Sand Tiger Shark
sand-tiger-shark.overview: The sand tiger shark (or Carcharias taurus), also known as the spotted ragged-tooth shark or blue-nurse sand tiger shark, is a large species of shark that lives in the shallow coastal waters of temperate and sub-tropical oceans across the world.

giant-tiger-land-snail.name: Giant Tiger Land Snail
giant-tiger-land-snail.overview: The giant tiger land snail (or Achatina achatina) is a large species of gastropod that lives in the woodland areas of West Africa; specifically Sierra Leone, Liberia, Ivory Coast, Ghana and Nigeria, among others.

sailfin-snapper.name: Sailfin Snapper
sailfin-snapper.overview: The sailfin snapper (or Symphorichthys spilurus), also known as the blue-lined sea bream, is a reef fish found throughout the Indo-Pacific region, ranging from the Maldives and Indonesia to northern Australia and the Solomon Islands.

ocean-sunfish.name: Ocean Sunfish
ocean-sunfish.overview: The ocean sunfish (Mola mola) is a large unusual-looking fish found in temperate and tropical oceans around the world.

palette-surgeonfish.name: Palette Surgeonfish
palette-surgeonfish.overview: The palette surgeonfish (or Paracanthurus hepatus), also commonly known as the blue tang or regal tang, is a fish found throughout the warm tropical waters of the Indo-Pacific region, ranging from East Africa and Japan to Australia and the Great Barrier Reef.

indian-ocean-oriental-sweetlips.name: Indian Ocean Oriental Sweetlips
indian-ocean-oriental-sweetlips.overview: The Indian Ocean oriental sweetlips (or Plectorhinchus vittatus) is a marine fish found throughout the Indo-Pacific, from the eastern coast of Africa and the Seychelles to Micronesia, Samoa, and as far south as Western Australia and New Caledonia.

yellow-tang.name: Yellow Tang
yellow-tang.overview: The yellow tang (or Zebrasoma flavescens) is a reef fish native to the central and western Pacific Ocean.

malayan-tapir.name: Malayan Tapir
malayan-tapir.overview: The Malayan tapir (or Tapirus indicus) is a mammal native to the rainforests of Southeast Asia.

mexican-redknee.name: Mexican Redknee
mexican-redknee.overview: The Mexican redknee (or Brachypelma hamorii) is a species of tarantula that lives in the scrublands, deserts and forests of Mexico.

sumatran-tiger.name: Sumatran Tiger
sumatran-tiger.overview: The Sumatran tiger (or Panthera tigris sumatrae, sometimes also Panthera tigris sondaica) is a subspecies of tiger native exclusively to the Indonesian island of Sumatra.

african-tigerfish.name: African Tigerfish
african-tigerfish.overview: The African tigerfish (or Hydrocynus vittatus) is a widespread and powerful freshwater predator found throughout sub-Saharan Africa in major river systems and lakes, including the Congo, Nile, Zambezi, Okavango, and Lake Tanganyika basins.

galápagos-giant-tortoise.name: Galápagos Giant Tortoise
galápagos-giant-tortoise.overview: The Galápagos giant tortoise (or Chelonoidis nigra) is a species of reptile endemic to the Galápagos Islands and does not appear anywhere else in the world.

toco-toucan.name: Toco Toucan
toco-toucan.overview: The toco toucan (or Ramphastos toco) is a bird native to central and eastern South America, with a wide range extending from the Guianas and northern Brazil south through Bolivia, Paraguay, northern Argentina and Uruguay.

golden-poison-frog.name: Golden Poison Frog
golden-poison-frog.overview: The golden poison frog (or Phyllobates terribilis), also known as the golden dart frog or golden poison arrow frog, is a species of poison dart frog endemic to the rainforests of the Pacific Coast of Colombia.

lehmann-s-poison-frog.name: Lehmann's Poison Frog
lehmann-s-poison-frog.overview: Lehmann's poison frog (or Oophaga lehmanni) is a species of amphibian endemic to the Colombian rainforests of the Anchicaya valley, and cannot be found anywhere else in the world.

red-eyed-tree-frog.name: Red-Eyed Tree Frog
red-eyed-tree-frog.overview: The red-eyed tree frog (or Agalychnis callidryas) is a species of arboreal amphibian that lives in the tropical rainforest regions of Central America.

golden-trevally.name: Golden Trevally
golden-trevally.overview: The golden trevally (or Gnathanodon speciosus) is a marine fish found throughout the tropical and subtropical waters of the Indo-Pacific region, ranging from the Red Sea and East Africa to the central Pacific islands.

clown-triggerfish.name: Clown Triggerfish
clown-triggerfish.overview: The clown triggerfish (or Balistoides conspicillum) inhabits clear tropical and subtropical coral reefs, lagoons, and reef slopes where it shelters in caves or crevices.

brown-trout.name: Brown Trout
brown-trout.overview: The brown trout (or Salmo trutta) is a widely distributed freshwater fish native to Europe, North Africa, and western Asia, and it has been introduced to many other regions including North America, South America, Australia, and New Zealand.

diamondback-terrapin.name: Diamondback Terrapin
diamondback-terrapin.overview: The diamondback terrapin (or Malaclemys terrapin) is a small species of turtle that lives in the brackish and coastal swamps of the Eastern and Southern United States of America.

hawksbill-turtle.name: Hawksbill Turtle
hawksbill-turtle.overview: The hawksbill turtle (or Eretmochelys imbricata) is a medium-sized sea turtle living in the Atlantic, Pacific, and Indian Oceans.

bluespine-unicornfish.name: Bluespine Unicornfish
bluespine-unicornfish.overview: The bluespine unicornfish (or Naso unicornis) inhabits tropical coral reefs, reef slopes, and outer reef drop-offs, where it occupies both shallow coastal waters and deeper reef zones.

desert-horned-viper.name: Desert Horned Viper
desert-horned-viper.overview: The desert horned viper (or Cerastes cerastes) is a venomous snake native to the deserts and semi-deserts of Northern Africa and the Middle East.

eastern-brown-snake.name: Eastern Brown Snake
eastern-brown-snake.overview: The Eastern brown snake (or Pseudonaja textilis) is a venomous species of reptile that lives in Australia and New Guinea.It prefers to live in dry areas so can be found in the grassland, scrubland and sparse forests.

western-diamondback-rattlesnake.name: Western Diamondback Rattlesnake
western-diamondback-rattlesnake.overview: The Western diamondback rattlesnake (or Crotalus atrox) is a species of venomous snake native to the deserts, grassland and scrubland of the USA and Mexico.

white-backed-vulture.name: White-Backed Vulture
white-backed-vulture.overview: The white-backed vulture (or Gyps africanus) is a large raptor native to sub-Saharan Africa, commonly found in open savannas, dry woodlands, and grasslands where it can easily locate carrion.

common-warthog.name: Common Warthog
common-warthog.overview: The common warthog (or Phacochoerus africanus) lives throughout Sub-Saharan Africa in a wide variety of environments.

black-wildebeest.name: Black Wildebeest
black-wildebeest.overview: The black wildebeest (or Connochaetes gnou) is a large ungulate species native to Southern Africa, also known as the white-tailed gnu after the distinctive noise they make when alarmed.

blue-wildebeest.name: Blue Wildebeest
blue-wildebeest.overview: The blue wildebeest (or Connochaetes taurinus) is a large antelope native to Southern Africa.

grey-wolf.name: Grey Wolf
grey-wolf.overview: Grey wolves (or Canis lupus) are a large canid species that live across most of the Northern hemisphere.

humphead-wrasse.name: Humphead Wrasse
humphead-wrasse.overview: The humphead wrasse (or Cheilinus undulatus), also known as the Napolean wrasse, is a large, reef-dwelling fish found throughout the tropical Indo-Pacific.

plains-zebra.name: Plains Zebra
plains-zebra.overview: The plains zebra (or Equus quagga) is native to Eastern and Southern Africa, preferring to live in easy reach of water sources on the savannah.
